question: Should the dashboard be permitted to publish fixture-only or reduced profiling output after a pinned OpenClaw lifecycle profile fails, provided the run emits warnings and removes partial artifacts?
rationale: This is an intentional automation-policy tradeoff between dashboard availability and strict pinned-runtime comparability; code review cannot determine the desired publication policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require visible degraded-output proof
options.body: Keep the fallback, but require a real after-fix run showing the cleanup and an explicit generated-output signal before merge.

options.title: Keep pinned profiling fail-closed
options.body: Retain the current behavior so a missing pinned profile blocks dashboard publication until the underlying lifecycle gap is repaired.

options.title: Accept warning-only fallback
options.body: Allow the workflow to continue based on Actions warnings alone, accepting that published dashboard data can omit pinned-runtime measurements.

recommendation.title: Require visible degraded-output proof
recommendation.body: Keep the fallback, but require a real after-fix run showing the cleanup and an explicit generated-output signal before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work establishes the dashboard and compatibility-lane behavior affected by this policy choice.
